problem_type: Execution authority checked after interactive approval
symptom: Locked bash stalls awaiting user approval instead of returning execution denial to the model when sandbox is unavailable.
direct_cause: laneHost before_tool calls approval preflight before native tool.execute checks durable coding access.
class_root: Prerequisite execution authority was enforced too late, inside the operation after approval.
affected_population: Step approval mode for locked native project operations
entry_points: Locked write in step approval mode
internal_only_reason: Internal hook order and durable access ownership. Existing SDK before_tool block contract is already used for surface authority; no upstream behavior change.
invariants: Native project authority is checked before preparation and approval, using the same durable coding access owner as execution.
generality_proof: The existing native assembly owns the set of coding tools and durable coding access query. A shared denial function is used by both host admission and direct execution, covering every locked native operation except read, whose trusted-skill path has its own authority.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive native project tool admission from durable coding access.
Return a tool error before side effects and approval.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: No-sandbox safe-auto and step fixture reproduce unwanted approval before coding denial.
Step mode reproduces same unwanted approval; safe-auto is a passing control.

recurrence.reason: Changing platform sandbox availability or approval mode reproduces the ordering bug.
same_class_scan: Inspected laneNativeApproval shell classifier and all LANE_CODING_TOOL_NAMES wrappers.
Inspected laneHost before_tool ordering, read trusted-skill exception and native assembly direct-execution tests.

prevention.invariant: Missing coding authority returns denial before approval.
prevention.failure_mode: before_tool returns block.reason; pi persists toolResult.isError and sends it to the model.
prevention.strategy: Reuse a single native admission query in host and execute wrappers.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace inline late-only check with the shared admission function; direct execution still consults the same owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing pi before_tool block API; application-owned authority ordering, not SDK failure.

migration: No stored format changes. Read the existing durable coding access entry.
residual_risks: Linux UI rerun belongs to remote CI; the no-sandbox difference is covered by the deterministic real-lane matrix. Local resident and all seven real-user journeys pass.
